source_note: Rewritten for master 2b540fe (the corpus-b-deps dependency-engine era): the README has no dependency section (it points to an external project wiki), so the oracle was compiled by hand from the in-repo dependency manifests. Scope = dependencies that need external artifacts in the default build: require_dep(...) (prebuilt/system mode) and the project's own find_package are runtime/optional; require_source_dep (liblouis/kddockwidgets/picojson/pugixml/utfcpp/googletest/crashpad_client/vst3sdk/lodepng/asiosdk) and mnxdom's FetchContent source mode are vendored, built with the project source and needing no external artifacts, so they are not in the oracle; require_tool/find_package(Git) are host build tools, listed as build. Optionality follows the CorpusBOptions.cmake defaults: CB_MODULE_AUDIO_JACK OFF, CB_MODULE_AUDIO_PIPEWIRE OFF, CB_MODULE_DRAW_USE_QTTEXTDRAW ON (-> msdfgen not enabled), CB_USE_SYSTEM_MNXDOM OFF (-> mnxdom is bundled as source by default; pkg_check only in system mode); CB_MODULE_AUDIO_EXPORT ON, CB_BUILD_IMPEXP_MNX_MODULE ON. The old oracle's (CI setup.sh + CB_COMPILE_USE_SYSTEM_* era) pulseaudio/openssl/tinyxml/ffmpeg no longer exist on master: direct PulseAudio use survives only in the embedded fluidsynth optional driver, and openssl is not referenced by any manifest.

deps.name: qt
deps.raw: Qt 6.8 (corpus-b-core/buildscripts/cmake/SetupQt6.cmake:90 find_package(Qt6 6.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS ${qt_components}), components Core/Gui/Widgets/Network/Qml/Quick/QuickControls2/QuickWidgets/Xml/Svg/ShaderTools/Core5Compat + conditionally NetworkAuth/PrintSupport/DBus/Concurrent/LinguistTools/WebSockets)

deps.name: alsa
deps.raw: find_package(ALSA REQUIRED) (corpus-b-core/framework/midi/CMakeLists.txt:80, corpus-b-core/framework/audio/driver/CMakeLists.txt:55, unconditional in the Linux branch)

deps.name: ogg
deps.raw: require_dep(ogg) (buildscripts/cmake/DependencyManifest.cmake:1 unconditional + corpus-b-core/buildscripts/cmake/ExtDepsManifest.cmake:41, CB_MODULE_AUDIO_EXPORT defaults to ON)

deps.name: freetype
deps.raw: require_dep(freetype) (ExtDepsManifest.cmake:14/18, CB_MODULE_DRAW_USE_FONTFACE_FT defaults to ON, STATIC_DEPS defaults to OFF)

deps.name: libpng
deps.raw: require_dep(libpng) (ExtDepsManifest.cmake:17, pulled in by freetype dynamic mode)

deps.name: nlohmann_json
deps.raw: require_dep(nlohmann_json) (DependencyManifest.cmake:12, CB_BUILD_IMPEXP_MNX_MODULE defaults to ON and CB_USE_SYSTEM_MNXDOM defaults to OFF)

deps.name: jack
deps.raw: find_package(Jack REQUIRED) (corpus-b-core/framework/audio/driver/CMakeLists.txt:72, CB_MODULE_AUDIO_JACK defaults to OFF, CorpusBOptions.cmake:42)

deps.name: msdfgen
deps.raw: require_dep(msdfgen) (ExtDepsManifest.cmake:24, only when NOT CB_MODULE_DRAW_USE_QTTEXTDRAW -- defaults to ON -> not enabled)

deps.name: pipewire
deps.raw: require_dep(pipewire) (ExtDepsManifest.cmake:50, CB_MODULE_AUDIO_PIPEWIRE defaults to OFF, enabled only in CI)

deps.name: mnxdom
deps.raw: pkg_check_modules(mnxdom REQUIRED) (src/importexport/mnx/CMakeLists.txt:14, only when CB_USE_SYSTEM_MNXDOM=ON; defaults to OFF -> bundled as source via FetchContent)

deps.name: git
deps.raw: find_package(Git REQUIRED) (corpus-b-core/buildscripts/cmake/SetupDependencies.cmake:29, used to get the revision number)

deps.name: crashpad_handler
deps.raw: require_tool(crashpad_handler) (ExtDepsManifest.cmake:62, CB_MODULE_DIAGNOSTICS_CRASHPAD_CLIENT defaults to OFF, on in CI)
